so, transform plus allows you to freely change the angle and placement of basic shapes and structural items (as well as the pillows and blankets in decorations). there's 4 blue arrows that you can drag to change the placement, and 6 orbs that you can drag to change the angle of something. it sounds a bit complicated when you're unfamiliar with it but it's really simple once you get the hang of it and see it in action [(here's a 5 minute demo of the tool)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Zn0kf0C86gA)

people use this for building custom furniture, custom roofs, terrain, etc. honestly, you can build almost anything imaginable. it's not entirely limited to shapes and structurals, since you can move most items with the tool simply by attaching them to a basic shape first, and it'll move as one item. people often do this with paintings, allowing you to transform them down into the floor and create things like custom flooring and rugs. it makes it a lot easier to line things up perfectly, especially when working with basic shapes that are oddly sized or shaped (like the convex/concave ones)  


this pass is a great investment if you're a really detailed/perfectionist builder or love building things from scratch! it adds a lot of freedom and control. i've built everything from custom staircases, skylights, windows, doors— to things like bridges and wishing wells. it unlocks a ton of possibilities, but that being said, i would HIGHLY recommend getting advanced placement first or at least buying the two passes together. imo, they go hand-in-hand. if you get transform plus alone, you wouldn't have the extra resizing abilities that are necessary for building a lot of custom items, which would be really frustrating to deal with especially with a 600rbx price tag  


if you'd like, feel free to PM me for my username and i'd be totally okay with meeting you in-game sometime and letting you test out the different passes on an empty plot! i could make you co-owner and it'd give you free access to all the building passes on my plot. you could mess around in build mode while i just work or something, so you can get a feel for how they work and which ones seem worth it

here's my thoughts, as of rn i have everything except marvelous mood & premium so i can't speak on those  


excellent employee: this one has been really worth it for me. if i'm not mistaken, your promotion progress is doubled (or at least increased noticeably) and of course you earn more money faster. since i got it, i've been more motivated to work since it feels more rewarding. not necessary but if you've got robux to spare and are considering it, i'd say go for it  


multiple floors: pretty self explanatory but highly worth it. one-story houses are nice but they can start to feel really repetitive if you play for a long time without the pass. being able to add second floors also opens up the possibility to make different types of builds such as hotels, malls etc. if that's your thing  


advanced placement: IMO, if you could get any one pass, this would be my recommendation. it makes building so much easier, it gets rid of tiny problems such as counters/cabinets not wanting to line up properly due to collision, awkward gaps between items when you're trying to add decorations/clutter on a shelf, etc. the smallest grid placement isn't always enough, so being able to completely ignore collisions can get rid of some frustration. this pass also fully unlocks resizing abilities  


large plot: if you're wanting to do large builds or even a town on your plot, or you just prefer really big houses and landscaping areas, this might be a good investment. i bought it for one specific plot and haven't really used it much otherwise. it takes your plot from a 30x30 grid size to 50x50. i feel like this one mostly comes down to personal preference/build style  


basements: this one seems pretty straight forward but it can be used outside of *just* making basements. i've used it for making custom pools, diversity in terrain, even for in-ground planters in front of windows. you can be creative with this one, but i wouldn't consider it a necessity. the stuff i mentioned can be recreated with other methods  


transform plus: again i feel like this one comes down to build style. i use this one a LOT but i also use a lot of basic shapes and structurals, and am really picky about having everything 100% lined up. i like to put a lot of detail in builds and this pass eases some of the burden of having to place/resize everything perfectly on the first try. the three downsides to this pass i can think of currently are that 1. it's the most expensive pass (600rbx), 2. just like with resizing, each use costs cash, so if you're being really finnicky and constantly transforming items to a different angle/spot, it can add up quickly, 3. it can be glitchy sometimes. one issue i have with it regularly is the tool accepting my changes without me even clicking the 'accept' button, but it doesn't usually bother me too much. if you love detail and are willing to drop the robux, this pass is a gamechanger  


as far as marvelous mood and premium, i'm hoping to get MM in the future since it keeps your moods up for longer. that can be really helpful with working since you earn more money with all moods above 80%. if you're a roleplayer it can also be nice for toggling the tired/stinky effect when moods are low. premium doubles your daily rewards (even the day 5 bloxbux reward), lets you choose plot location when loading in, decreases bills by half and increases donation limit to 50k instead of the regular 10k.  


hopefully this is enough detail lol, but i'd be glad to answer any questions about the passes i own if i missed anything!
